placements.why: Establishes the organizational strategy category covering recovery mechanisms, fault tolerance, and resilience verification.
placements.title: operational recovery mechanisms require routine verification to exist as real capabilities
placements.frame: How does the organization build, test, and maintain recovery mechanisms and operational resilience?

placements.title: unrehearsed rollback mechanisms are theoretical rather than actual capabilities
placements.frame: How does regular rehearsal convert theoretical recovery plans into verified operational capabilities?
placements.why: Quinton mandates a monthly rollback drill cadence for Atlas on the foundational principle that unpracticed recovery procedures cannot be relied upon in reality.
